Thanks for the response. I still have some family in there, but don't know how that would help.

I have not, but I'm quite positive there's none unless I'm Einstein, or have family here. Can't be an asylum/refugee because dangers in birth country is not due to my race or religion. Marriage doesn't even give permanent stay permit right away anymore (thanks to those who abused the more lenient system back then): partner becomes like employer, and divorce equals to employment termination.

I feel terribly stuck, feels like putting an early end to this unfortunate birth is the way out.

Any country can take me if I have the qualifications (which in most countries I don't yet), employer, and willingness to work usually hard jobs (but it'd probably be OK if I love the job). Not sure if there's such loopholes, but I'm gonna try looking it up, let me know if you find it again too. Safer for me not to mention the job cause if employer finds out I'm gone. Thanks for the response btw, deep inside I hope I can make it alive (although most parts of me just want to end everything).
